title: Birthdays Around the World
subtitle: 考点：for example / 不同习俗
passage: People celebrate birthdays in different ways. In China, many people eat long noodles on their birthdays. The noodles are a symbol of a long life. In the UK, people put candles on a cake. The birthday boy or girl makes a wish and blows out the candles.
In Mexico, children break a pinata full of sweets at the party. For example, in some families the child can choose the game. Birthdays are a happy time for everyone, in every language.
vocab: celebration 庆典 · for example 例如 · symbol 象征 · international 国际的 · language 语言 · own 自己的
